modules.name: unsloth/__init__.py
modules.responsibility: Import-time backend gate (_IS_MLX): routes to MLX branch or _gpu_init; MLX shims torch.cuda API to no-ops.

modules.name: unsloth/_gpu_init.py
modules.responsibility: GPU path: patches trl/transformers/peft at import, applies import_fixes, redirects HF cache.

modules.name: unsloth/models/loader.py
modules.responsibility: FastModel/FastLanguageModel/FastVisionModel public API; from_pretrained dispatch, quantization selection, get_peft_model.

modules.name: unsloth/models/*.py (llama, mistral, qwen2/3, gemma, ...)
modules.responsibility: Per-family 'Fast' model classes with pre_patch/post_patch swapping HF modules for manual kernels.

modules.name: unsloth/kernels/*.py
modules.responsibility: Manual Triton/CUDA kernels + patch_* functions: RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, GeGLU, cross-entropy, fast LoRA, FP8, flex-attention.

modules.name: unsloth/optimizers/*.py
modules.responsibility: GaLore (gradient low-rank projection) AdamW for memory-efficient training.

modules.name: unsloth/registry/*.py
modules.responsibility: MODEL_REGISTRY / ModelInfo / QuantType; per-family registrars; search_models() catalog for Studio.

modules.name: unsloth/dataprep/*.py
modules.responsibility: Raw-text & synthetic dataset loaders/preprocessors (torch-free on MLX).

modules.name: unsloth_cli/
modules.responsibility: Typer app + commands (start/train/chat/inference/export/studio) + subagent MCP (claude/codex) + tool policy.

modules.name: studio/
modules.responsibility: Tauri desktop: Rust backend + TS frontend + Python backend; model run/train, data recipes, MCP server, AGPL-3.0.
